== Source and scope ==

The report's own heading dates the event to 23 January 2010; the forum post was published on 24 January. The body explicitly gives ten players, the two cubes, the deck-construction method, four matches, Graham's win and the author's second place.<ref name="report">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=33296#p505059 ATL CUBE DRAFT 1/23/10], Throdo, Players Committee Forums (24 January 2010).</ref>

The article retains ATL as the event label. It does not infer a venue or municipality. Graham, Tommy, Jeremy and Throdo remain as named in the source, without unsupported legal-name expansions. The reported finishes do not establish places for the other eight players. The approximate game differentials are not converted into exact scores.

The description of deck construction belongs to this event report; it is not a claim that all cube events follow the same rules. The report discusses a proposed later card-text change, which is not treated as an implemented change here. No spreadsheet contents have been used to establish the event's rules or results.
